question: for 九空/五虛/小耗/五墓: does a generic puzhu:06 trigger lift the god's 忌 (Q4-GENERIC), or only the god's own lifters (GOD-NARROW)?

九空.entry: 忌進人口修倉庫開市立劵交易納財開倉庫出貨財　　寅申月值滿日子午卯酉月值開日與月德天德合月德合併則不忌己亥月值月厭從月厭論辰戌丑未月值破日從月破論

ownLifters.note: officer clause 寅申→滿, 子午卯酉→開 is descriptive: 九空 (辰丑戌未 by month) always falls on that officer in those months (checked below), so the officer-AND-德 and 德-alone readings coincide

九空.currentProduction: QL: lift on any trigger not in liftExclusionsV4 (Q4 yes)

五虛.entry: 忌修倉庫開倉庫出貨財　　與天德月德天德合月德合六合併則不忌{{SK notes|天赦不得與五虛併天願必是六合故不言而已在其中}}

ownLifters.note: 天願 by the 四庫 note 「天願必是六合故不言而已在其中」; 天赦 never meets 五虛 (same note)

五虛.currentProduction: QL: lift on any trigger not in liftExclusionsV4 (Q4 yes)

小耗.entry: 忌修倉庫開市立劵交易納財開倉庫出貨財與天德月德天德合月德合天願併則不忌子午卯酉月值刼煞雖與德合併猶忌

ownLifters.note: own exception 「子午卯酉月值刼煞雖與德合併猶忌」 (猶忌 survives its own lifters)

小耗.currentProduction: QL: lift on any trigger not in liftExclusionsV4 (Q4 yes)

五墓.entry: 忌冠帶行幸遣使安撫邊境選將訓兵出師上官赴任臨政親民結婚姻納采問名嫁娶進人口般移安牀解除求醫療病營建宮室修宮室繕城郭興造動土豎柱上梁開市立劵交易修置産室栽種牧養納畜破土安葬啟攢　　{{SK anchor|五月十一月與月德併則不忌}}　　按五墓乃五行旺干臨於墓庫故所忌如此與月德併則為三合旺氣發於天干而不可以墓論矣故不忌也不取德合者不同行也

ownLifters.note: 「五月十一月與月德併」: 月德 meets the 五墓 day only in 午/子 months (checked below); Q4a 「不取德合者」 excludes 天德合/月德合

五墓.currentProduction: QL: lift on any trigger not in liftExclusionsV4 (Q4 yes, Q4a block 天德合/月德合)

classes.Q4a: OWNER_RULING (2026-10-16) on SOURCE_FACT 「不取德合者不同行也」

q4a.says: 五墓 「不取德合者不同行也」: 五墓's own lift needs 月德 itself; 德合 does not stand in
q4a.why: without it, puzhu:06's 天德合/月德合 triggers would lift 五墓 on days its own entry refuses
q4a.class: OWNER_RULING (Q4a = block, 2026-10-16) applying a SOURCE_FACT clause
q4a.witnesses: 06067693-n95 巳-丙戌 (天德合): both models keep; consistent with Q4a, non-discriminating
q4a.observableQ4Difference: none: over 720 contexts generic and narrow agree on every 五墓 row (non-德合 triggers only meet 五墓 alongside a keep-class source)

cleanCriteria: target god active (on the page, no own lifter, not deferred)
no own lifter of that god present (incl. non-trigger 六合 for 五虛)
no other 忌 operand on the heading (卷十一 list ∩ page operands, plus graded/又為 sources the composer reports)
heading not made uninterpretable (day rule, protected row)
page authenticated (stored hash = prior record hash, month from officer = month block)
heading maps canonically (劵/券 and glyph variants only)
the two models predict different final states for the context-heading
independentYi: kept, not contamination: recorded per cell as otherYi

models.narrow: same composer, liftExclusions[god] = puzhu:06 triggers outside the god's own lifters
models.antiFitting: predictions come mechanically from the shipped composer plus own-lifter sets read from the 卷十 text; the exclusion sets were not tuned to any page. models.json was dumped before the printed states were encoded, but n126 had already been read
models.byConstruction: outside 九空 defer months, no puzhu:06 row carries a god together with one of its own lifters (P4-C applied the own list first): every QL row discriminates

inventory.reconciled: same 27 pages; a first pass missed 4 whose prior records store god lists as one space-separated string (n105, n117, 06067694-n93, 06067697-n75)

findings.n126: 卯-丁巳 五虛 × 開倉庫出貨財 is the only clean witness. Printed only_ji. Generic predicts only_yi (wrong on 宜 and 忌); narrow predicts both_present (right on 忌, wrong on 宜). No model reproduces the page: classification C. On the 忌 axis alone the page supports GOD-NARROW.
findings.yiAxis: 開倉庫出貨財 宜 operands 月恩+四相+滿日 are present and the 宜 line omits the heading: with 五虛's 忌 surviving, the page reads 從忌不從宜, not both_present. F1 R2 rule 3 (owner) states the opposite for 五離 × 立券交易 (independent 宜 + surviving 忌 = both_present), which governs the 4 extrapolated rows. Different god and heading, so no contradiction is established; open debt, not resolved here.
findings.stage2Testable: Stage 2 named 丑-戊寅, 丑-壬寅 and 戌-癸亥 as testable for 五虛: wrong. 劫煞 (and 天賊 on 丑 pages) is a second 開倉庫出貨財 忌 operand on all of them; 丑-寅 rows are not even touched by puzhu:06
findings.wumu: no observable Q4 difference for 五墓 anywhere in 720 contexts
findings.jiukongXiaohaoKaicang: 九空 × 開倉庫出貨財 discriminating contexts all carry 五虛 too (joint only); 小耗 × 開倉庫出貨財 has only 戌-癸卯 with 大時 (contaminated)

f1.rule3: An independent 宜 on 立券交易 does not suppress the surviving 五離 忌 (both_present).
f1.scope: 五離 × 立券交易 only; not extended here
f1.extrapolatedRows: SEMANTIC_CONSEQUENCE; not used as Q4-REST evidence
